title: Strike Robot
intro: Strike Robot builds the software stack for physical AI: SR Platform creates simulation-ready worlds and assets from language, SR Agentic gives robots task-shaped understanding of the real world, and both are tested on humanoids, quadrupeds and arms in simulation and on real hardware.

sections.title: SR Platform
sections.text: SR Platform generates physics-valid simulation environments, production-grade 3D assets and training-ready datasets from a single natural-language description. Generated assets pass validation gates for geometry, articulation and physics readiness.
features: 3D geometry from text, or a real object reconstructed from photos, with physically based materials.
Full environments composed from language, with physics constraints built in.
Robot policy rollouts in generated scenes, with sensor, collision and success data exported.
Swap assets and change physics or lighting without leaving the platform.

videos.title: From prompt to simulation-ready
videos.text: A prompt becomes assets and scenes; validation gates check geometry, articulation and physics, and feedback guides refinement.

videos.title: Articulated assets
videos.text: A fully functional asset with several degrees of freedom, built by SR Platform.

videos.title: Soft, elastic objects
videos.text: From a prompt to a simulation-ready soft, elastic object.

videos.title: One month after launch
videos.text: Richer geometry, higher-fidelity surface materials and more realistic assets than at launch.

sections.title: SR Agentic
sections.problem: Robots acting on stale or hallucinated world models
sections.text: SR Agentic is an intelligence layer between perception and action. It turns a natural-language task into a lean, task-shaped world model, runs a fast safety loop on the robot and deep reasoning in the cloud only when something new happens, and verifies before it commits.
features: Builds only the spatial structure the task needs: the map is a function of the task.
Detects and grounds objects it was never trained on, fusing detection, segmentation and captioning.
Change detection updates the world model and the planner re-plans on the fly.
Confidence gating, grounded retrieval and visual checks: the robot abstains and re-checks instead of guessing.

sections.title: SafeGuard ASF
sections.text: SR Agentic on the Unitree G1 humanoid for autonomous industrial safety: fire and smoke, abnormal pipeline temperature and intruders in restricted zones, with ReAct reasoning over 23 tools and learned locomotion policies.

local_video.title: Tracking a worker
local_video.text: The G1 recognizes a worker in protective gear and keeps tracking them.

sections.title: Simulation to reality
sections.problem: Behaviors that work in simulation but not on the robot
sections.text: A real laboratory is reconstructed inside SR Platform so that behaviors validated in simulation can be checked against the real space. The simulation stack is open source.

videos.title: A real lab, reconstructed
videos.text: Part of a real laboratory rebuilt in SR Platform, to carry behaviors from simulation into reality.

sections.title: Legged robots
sections.problem: Autonomy without relying on the cloud
sections.text: Humanoids and quadrupeds that turn camera, depth and LiDAR data into maps and actions, with on-device inference on Qualcomm edge hardware so they keep working offline.

videos.title: A brain on its back

videos.title: Why edge computing
videos.text: Low-latency on-device VLM/VLA inference, offline navigation and longer deployments on less power.

sections.title: Contact-rich and deformable objects
sections.problem: Physics that is hard to simulate
sections.text: Assets with realistic contact, friction and deformation: cloth that can be grabbed, pulled and draped, articulated objects, and physical properties validated in simulation.
